'''Starblades''' were small [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-thrown [[Force power/Legends|energy]] weapons employed by some Force users, notably the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]].
